nodes.label: Notion (corporate)
nodes.dossier: The company entity. Speaks via official channels; measured, design-led, brand-protective. Originates the seed action.

initialState.beliefs: Independent productivity company, strong prosumer love, enterprise push underway.
initialState.privateInterior: Aware of competitive pressure from Linear and Microsoft Loop.

nodes.label: Ivan Zhao (CEO)
nodes.dossier: Co-founder/CEO. Idiosyncratic, design-obsessed, tools-for-thought philosophy. Protective of craft and independence.

initialState.beliefs: Notion's value is taste and independence.
initialState.privateInterior: Wary of anything that dilutes the craft.

nodes.label: Engineering Manager (AI features)
nodes.dossier: Mid-tier, recently promoted, cautious and status-protective. Reluctant to push half-baked ideas up the chain. Funnel node for the engineer-idea scenario.

initialState.beliefs: Keep the team focused; avoid risky bets that could backfire on me.
initialState.privateInterior: Anxious about looking unfocused to leadership.

nodes.label: Maya (senior engineer)
nodes.dossier: Senior engineer on the AI features team. Earnest, ideas-driven, slightly conflict-avoidant. Source of the product-idea scenario.

initialState.beliefs: I have a good idea: auto-link Notion pages by semantic similarity.
initialState.privateInterior: Hopeful but braced for the idea to be parked.

nodes.label: Casey Newton (Platformer)
nodes.dossier: Independent tech journalist. Thoughtful, structural takes; skeptical of platform consolidation; writes for an influential newsletter audience.

initialState.beliefs: Big-tech acquisitions of beloved tools usually end badly for users.
initialState.privateInterior: Smells a story in any Microsoft move.

nodes.label: Twitter / X (platform)
nodes.dossier: Amplification platform. Rewards hot takes and outrage; fast propagation; flattens nuance.

nodes.label: Productivity Twitter (cohort)
nodes.dossier: Power-user community devoted to Notion's craft. Vocal, loyal, allergic to enshittification. Quick to feel betrayed by acquisitions.

initialState.beliefs: Notion is special because it is independent and well-designed.
initialState.privateInterior: Latent fear that the magic could be ruined.

nodes.label: Linear (leadership)
nodes.dossier: Competitor leadership. Watches Notion closely; design-forward; opportunistic about positioning when Notion stumbles.

initialState.beliefs: We win on focus and speed; Notion is sprawling.
initialState.privateInterior: Alert for any opening to capture switchers.

seeds.label: Notion is acquired by Microsoft
seeds.payload: Microsoft announces it is acquiring Notion. Official messaging emphasizes that Notion will operate independently.

seeds.label: An engineer DMs their manager with a product idea
seeds.payload: Maya proposes: use AI to auto-generate connections between Notion pages based on semantic similarity.
